descriptionNullable:
This dataset contains raw job posting data collected from TopCV.vn using Selenium.

The data is intentionally kept in its original (raw) form and has not been cleaned or normalized.
It is suitable for data cleaning, preprocessing, and exploratory analysis exercises.

Data source: TopCV.vn 
Collected for educational and research purposes only.

| Column     | Description                                                                |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| title      | title Job                      |
| company    | company name                                           |
| location   |  location (VN)          |
| experience | required experience       |
| salary     | salary information  |
| date_post  | job posting date                                   |
| url        | same with it's name                                            |
